subject: Post-demo privacy intake — DPA request, SCC module choice & VSQ kickoff
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@zenledger.com>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, dev.patel@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo privacy intake — DPA request, SCC module choice & VSQ kickoff

Hi Aisha,

Thanks again for your time today — great conversation and appreciate the clarity on your data flows. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we can keep momentum with your procurement and legal teams:

1) High-level findings from call
- ZenLedger will act as controller for customer financial data; Redwood will be processor for hosted inference traffic.
- Primary concern: cross-border transfers between EU customers and Redwood’s hosted models; ZenLedger also needs HIPAA mapping for a narrow subset of medical-claims metadata.
- ZenLedger prefers contract standardization over bespoke redlines if possible.

2) DPA & SCC module
- Per our discussion, you asked whether SCC Module 2 (Processor-focused) is the typical path for customers who are controllers. We usually recommend the DPAs with SCC Module 2 for controller-to-processor relationships, but we’ll confirm legal nuance with our team.

3) SOC 2 / HIPAA posture
- You asked about SOC 2 compliance: Redwood maintains a current SOC 2 Type II report (available under NDA). For HIPAA, we support BAAs for qualifying workloads — will flag Legal for next steps.

4) Vendor security questionnaire (VSQ)
- If you’re ok, I’ll kick off your VSQ and attach our DPA template for legal review. Please send the initial questionnaire you prefer (if different from the attached stub).

Next actions (owner / ETA)
- Aisha: confirm controller status + point of contact for legal (if different) — ETA: EOD Wed Aug 4
- Soojin: share Redwood DPA template + VSQ starter (attached) — DONE
- Marissa (Legal): advise on SCC module mapping and if DPA template needs changes for HIPAA + cross-border clauses — ETA: Fri Aug 6
- Dev (SE): prepare short notes on data minimization and key management for VSQ questions — ETA: Thu Aug 5

Attachments: zenledger_dpa_questionnaire_20270803.pdf (DPA + short Qs), zenledger_vsq_initial.xlsx (VSQ stub)

If that looks right I’ll loop in Marissa and Dev to start formal intake. Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee | Enterprise Solutions 
Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@zenledger.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: LegalOps Team <legalops@zenledger.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 09:31:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo privacy intake — DPA request, SCC module choice & VSQ kickoff

Hi Soojin — thanks for the write-up and the attachments. Quick answers from our side: 

- Confirmed: ZenLedger will act as controller for customer transactional and PII content. The medical-related fields you saw are limited to a single product line; I can connect you to our HIPAA lead (cc’d LegalOps).
- SCC preference: our legal team typically asks for Processor-focused SCC language; they suggested Module 2 during today's call. If Redwood’s standard DPA + Module 2 is available that is preferred.
- SOC2: we require a current SOC2 Type II from vendors. Please share yours (NDA is fine).

Attached our intake VSQ (filled to the best of our knowledge) — note the section around encryption-at-rest asks for KMS details and key rotation cadence.

Next for us: legal will review Redwood DPA template once you loop them in. I’ll also pull procurement onto the thread if we need PO terms.

Thanks,
Aisha Khan
Head of Procurement, ZenLedger
aisha.khan@zenledger.com
Attachment: zenledger_vsq_initial.xlsx

Subject: Fwd: Post-demo privacy intake — DPA request, SCC module choice & VSQ kickoff

Folks — forwarding the customer reply and their VSQ. High level asks from ZenLedger:
- Confirm Redwood SOC2 Type II report (we’ll send NDA link)
- Confirm we can route the DPA with SCC Module 2 (processor-focused) and call out BAA paths for HIPAA-relevant traffic
- Provide KMS / encryption-at-rest notes for VSQ

Marissa: can you review the attached DPA template and confirm whether Module 2 maps cleanly to controller-processor language for their use case, and whether we should add a short HIPAA BAA addendum for the product line they called out?

Dev: can you draft a 2-paragraph technical note on key management, rotation cadence, and isolation for customers that I can paste into the VSQ? Also note any limitations for customer-held keys.

Proposed next step: legal + SE co-edit the DPA and VSQ responses; I’ll send updated docs back to Aisha and her LegalOps contact.

Thanks — Soojin
